title: OXCART production facilities: A-12 airframes on assembly floor (p. 279)
description: Elevated black-and-white photograph of a factory floor with several A-12 airframes under construction, surrounded by scaffolding, ladders and work stands. The caption reads "OXCART production facilities." Text below discusses Lockheed's search for hydraulic fluid and pumps and the difficulties of working with titanium for the airframe.
